Resolves #19311

A tooltip whose target was left inside the show delay appeared a moment later and stayed. The leave now clears the pending show. `addTimeout` also passed the timer handle to the name-keyed `clearTimeout`, which cleared nothing, so a delay armed twice leaked its first timer past any hide. It now clears its predecessor by name.

Evidence: L2 (unit arms on the class's own methods with real timers; the tooltip component specs in a real browser) → L2 required.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `DelayTimers.spec` › "a target left inside the show delay never shows the tooltip". Red on dev: one show, still mounted |
| AC-2 | `DelayTimers.spec` › "a delay armed twice keeps one timer…". Red on dev: one show after the hide |
| AC-3 | `DelayTimers.spec` › "a target held past the show delay shows…, and leaving hides it after the hide delay". Green on dev and after |
| AC-4 | `DockActionTooltips`, `tooltip/NestedTheme` and `tooltip/ThemeProjection` component specs 6/6 |

None.

## Test Evidence
- Full engine unit 4752 passed, 2 skipped. Tooltip unit 6/6.
- Mutations: without the leave's `clearTimeout('show')`, only AC-1's arm goes red. With the old `addTimeout`, only AC-2's arm goes red.
